hero.title: Nvidia's $350 Billion Scare: What Happens If Jensen Huang Leaves?
hero.description: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% amid spy allegations. The stock was already weakening, and investors now face a bigger question: Who replaces Jensen Huang if he suddenly leaves?

latest.description: The Japanese automaker said the plant will focus on hybrid vehicles and is expected to begin production in 2029.

latest.description: President Trump's questioning of the legitimacy of his loss in the 2020 election culminated with an attack on the U.S. Capitol by a mob of his supporters.

latest.title: The issues a 'really frustrated' Trump may actually work with Democrats on, according to former Speaker Paul Ryan
latest.description: Former House Speaker Paul Ryan said President Donald Trump is likely to become frustrated governing with a Democratic-controlled Congress.

latest.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
latest.description: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

latest.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
latest.description: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

latest.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
latest.description: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

latest.title: We're adding a consumer stock to diversify beyond the volatile AI trade
latest.description: We wanted to add a less cyclical company with a cheap valuation and that consistently returns capital to its shareholders.

latest.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
latest.description: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

latest.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
latest.description: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

latest.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
latest.description: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

latest.title: Nvidia's CEO turmoil gives newly empowered Democrats fresh ammunition in pursuit of oversight
latest.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy comes as the company is already about to face heightened scrutiny.

latest.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
latest.description: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

latest.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
latest.description: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.
